summary: Factory daemon status persistence must store a compact last_result summary instead of the full tick result payload, or JSON encoding on cycle-end state writes can block the main loop long enough for watchdog churn.
symptoms: tick.finally completed=true and run_forever.after_tick appear in factory_daemon.tick.log but factory_daemon_state.json stays at last_tick_at=null
faulthandler stack shows json.encoder frames during cycle-end persistence
watchdog restarts daemon even though the tick body already completed

preferred_fix.strategy: persist a compact last_result summary in factory_daemon_state.json and keep detailed runtime data in dedicated summary files
